# Consumer confidence dips in September amid inflation concerns

U.S. consumer sentiment dipped to a four-month low in September amid rising inflation rates and mounting cost-of-living concerns, according to survey results released Friday.

The University of Michigan Surveys of Consumers index found that consumer confidence slipped to a reading of 48.1 in September, a 7 percent decrease from August and 15 percent less than in January. [...] The measure uses how people feel about personal finances, as well as the broader economy, to predict future spending — which accounts for the bulk of U.S. economic activity.
